messages:
maddy: quick q — i'm updating a terraform module to centralize SA creation across namespaces and want to add the IRSA annotation via helm overrides. thinking: create kubernetes_service_account in infra tf and set annotation eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn, then helm chart should reference that SA. any obvious downsides?

sam: sounds reasonable. couple things: IRSA needs the OIDC provider present in the account and the IAM role trust policy to allow sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity for that service account sub: `system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa>`

ben: fwiw we should avoid adding annotations to the namespace object — must be on the ServiceAccount resource itself. if you create SA in TF and the chart also tries to create it, you'll get conflicts unless chart supports `createServiceAccount: false` + providing `serviceAccount.name`

maddy: yes chart has `serviceAccount.create` toggle. my plan: tf creates SA, chart disables creation and uses `serviceAccount.name`, and i pass annotations via `serviceAccount.annotations`. is it ok to set annotations from TF (kubernetes_service_account) and not pass them as helm overrides?

sam: that works. just ensure the helm templates don't patch/replace the SA later. some charts render SA even if create=false (rare). also remember cert-manager/other controllers might read SA annotations for IRSA.

lina: security note — we need to record role ARNs in our KMS-encrypted secrets inventory (compliance). if TF will create the IAM role + binding, it should also tag the role and emit outputs for tracking.

ben: minor infra gotcha: when switching from chart-managed SA to TF-managed SA, you'll need a rolling restart for pods to pick up the projected token changes (the projected token mount name and token audience are injected at pod creation). patching deployments with an annotation is easiest.

maddy: how do you recommend doing the rolling restart? kubectl rollout restart deploy/foo? or patch annotation on deployment via terraform?

sam: `kubectl rollout restart` is fine for one-offs. if you're baking it into the infra change, add a small lifecycle-triggering annotation on the Deployment in TF, e.g. `kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt: "$(date -Iseconds)"` (or set via provider template). but be careful with large deployments.

ben: also check projected token TTLs — EKS token TTL default is 1h for TokenRequest. some sidecars read token expiration on startup so a restart is needed right away.

maddy: example of TF SA resource i'm planning to add:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "svc" {
  metadata {
    name      = var.sa_name
    namespace = var.namespace
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = var.iam_role_arn
    }
  }
}
```

ben: looks good. also consider adding ownerReferences or labels so it's obvious in UI which stack owns it.

sam: helm override snippet if you choose chart side:
```yaml
serviceAccount:
  create: false
  name: my-chart-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/my-role
```

lina: question — do we need to update the IAM OIDC trust policy when rotating OIDC thumbprint or changing cluster? make that part of the runbook if TF deploys the role/trust.

maddy: TF will create the role but not the OIDC provider (that's separate infra). i'll add a precheck to ensure the provider exists. any tooling to validate that quickly?

sam: you can use `aws eks describe-cluster` output (oidc issuer URL) and `aws iam list-open-id-connect-providers` to check. we also have a small script in infra repo `tools/check-oidc.sh` that compares the issuer. ping me and i'll point you to it.

ben: final checklist from me: ensure chart set `serviceAccount.create=false`, TF exports SA name and annotations, add deployment restart plan, update runbook for role tagging + outputs, and add a short smoke test that calls tokenreview or uses `kubectl auth can-i` with `--as=system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa>`

maddy: great checklist — i'll make the PR now. tagging @sam for the precheck script if you can share.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: namespace "payments" deployment "api" will be restarted by maddy in 15m :gear:

maddy: thanks all — i'll do the PR and include the minimal tf/helm examples and the restart instructions in the PR description. will link back here for review.
